text:
matt: Vendor notified us that eu-west1 standby capacity is being throttled for a cooldown window starting ~2024-10-03 20:00 UTC. They said this will affect fallback instances used by our autoscaler. Link: https://vendor.portal/alerts/ALRT-2024-10-03
sarah: Is this just standby or does it hit preemptible/spots too?
vendor-bot: Affecting standby + spot fallback pools in eu-west1 only. Reserved/dedicated pools are unaffected. Expected impact window ~4-10 hours depending on vendor progress.
matt: Short-term plan: 1) route CI/quick jobs to us-central if possible; 2) mark demo/staging with an eviction-friendly tag so autoscaler deprioritizes them; 3) request vendor protection for our top-2 CI projects.
oliver: I can add the tag & scheduler override. Proposed TF snippet (will open PR):
```
resource "redwood_allocation_tag" "evictable" {
  name = "evictable-during-eu-cooldown"
}
resource "redwood_project_allocation" "staging" {
  project = "proj-staging-7"
  tags = [redwood_allocation_tag.evictable.name]
}
```
ci-bot: CI notice: moving nightly suites for proj-demo-3 -> us-central tonight at 21:30 UTC. Jobs will be queued locally until routing completes.
sarah: vendor-bot  can you confirm how many projects we can shield via support ticket?
vendor-bot: We can add 2 protected projects per account for this window. Opening ticket #ALRT-555. ETA response ~90 mins.
matt: Priority for protection: 1) proj-ci-main, 2) proj-analytics-sandbox. If vendor pushes back, we'll promote proj-ci-main only and route analytics to us-central.
oliver: I'll open PR for scheduler override + runtime flag: https://github.com/redwood/scheduler/pull/2034 (draft). It sets scheduling_weight=5 for "evictable" projects and adds runtime flag eu_cooldown_20241003.
sarah: Can we canary the tag on proj-staging-7 only before wide rollout? I'll run a single smoke job on staging tonight.
matt: Yes. @oliver only apply to proj-staging-7 first. Hold bulk changes until vendor reply.
ci-bot: Canary started on proj-staging-7 at 20:45 UTC. Job id: ci-98765. Will report success/fail.
oliver: PR opened and linked in infra ticket. Will not apply TF until ticket resolves.
vendor-bot: Support updated: ticket #ALRT-555 placed on expedite queue. If you reply with the two protected project names in the ticket, we can usually confirm within ~60-90 minutes.
sarah: Replying now. Also pinged SRE to silence autoscaler pages for noise during the window.
matt: Thanks. If vendor can't protect proj-analytics-sandbox, we shift its long runs to us-central starting 21:00 UTC. I'll post rollback plan and timeline once vendor replies.
ci-bot: Canary finished: job ci-98765 completed and was deprioritized as expected (start delayed by 2m, ran on fallback pool). No failures.
matt: Great. Waiting on vendor ticket. Will update when protection confirmed.
